evals.prompt: Review whether the LikeC4 model should change after adding a new shared verification provider module.
evals.expected_output: Checks settings.gradle.kts, docs/c4 model/views, verification seam ownership, and recommends a focused model/view update or no-op.

evals.prompt: This LikeC4 view is getting crowded after adding persistence relationships. Review it.
evals.expected_output: Flags readability issues, suggests splitting by persistence/capability/runtime perspective, and preserves stable view names where possible.

evals.prompt: A feature's data module added implementation(projects.shared.srs.engine) and uses SrsStorage, but the LikeC4 model shows no edge from that feature to the SRS engine. Review.
evals.expected_output: Cross-checks build.gradle.kts/imports (and graphify) against model relationships, confirms the dependency in source, flags the missing depends edge, and recommends adding it with the right relationship kind.

evals.prompt: Audit whether all planned (#prepared/#future) architecture in the model is reviewable, including planned navigation between sections.
evals.expected_output: Notes that query-by-tags returns only elements, audits relationship tags via read-view/find-relationships, and checks that planned cross-feature navigation is collected in the cross_feature_navigation view rather than scattered or modeled as fake elements.

evals.prompt: Some LikeC4 view titles use English category prefixes (Runtime/Planned) and others Russian (Структура/Компоненты), and two flows have no prefix. Review.
evals.expected_output: Flags the inconsistent category-prefix scheme (not a language-policy violation, since technical proper nouns may stay English) and recommends one consistent Russian prefix set used as a LikeC4 navigation group.
